summary: Backend testing complete for Trivia GerabDevSoft MVP. Executed 27 pytest cases covering health, auth (Emergent OAuth session exchange 401 path), protected endpoints (all 401 without token), RBAC (non-admin 403), admin seed verification (admin@usfx.bo with is_admin=true), 8 seed questions, admin CRUD (questions, prizes, schedule, settings), full E2E flow (create question -> schedule -> user answers -> points increment -> weekly ranking includes user), duplicate/unscheduled answer rejection (400), prize image upload (base64 -> Binary in MongoDB) with GET /api/prizes/{id}/image returning correct Content-Type, prize deletion cascades image (404), weekly raffle (winner selected, prize.executed=true, re-execution blocked), active raffle (same), raffle history, and manual notification broadcast. Push (Emergent) and Resend (email) are placeholder-mocked and log warnings without blocking - VERIFIED as MOCKED per PRD. All 27/27 tests passed. Google OAuth end-to-end cannot be automated (browser flow); tested by seeding sessions directly in Mongo as documented in test_credentials.md.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1080 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, prizes, raffles) for maintainability though not blocking
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, informational)

list_prizes endpoint (/api/prizes) requires auth but PrizeOut fields are constructed inconsistently: uses `has_image_flag` fallback which is never written by admin_create_prize (writes `has_image`). Current code still returns correct value via fallback, but the pop key is dead code - minor cleanup opportunity
In submit_answer, selected_index bounds check happens after uniqueness check; harmless but could validate earlier for cleaner errors
Emergent Push and Resend are correctly wired but keys are placeholders (MOCKED) - not sending real notifications in dev, as expected
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed with test_user_* and prizes/questions prefixed TEST_ are created and cleaned up via session-scoped autouse fixture. Admin session tokens (test_*) are also cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_trivia_backend.py using pytest. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for public URL. Admin/user sessions are seeded directly in mongo (Google OAuth cannot be automated). Push and Resend are placeholder-mocked. Frontend not tested (backend-only request).
